svg.title: R-aux-P - Power Distribution - plan
svg.text: Power Distribution takes the reactor's output, transforms and conditions it, stores the surge in capacitor banks
and feeds the ship's buses; one technician monitors it and does the switching.
Tool cabinet and spares (west wall, south of the door)
Breaker panels and first aid (west wall, north of the door)
Diagnostic cart and spares trolley (main aisle)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
